items.title: 18.7.3 Effect of Ligand Exchange on the Colour of Complexes

source_refs.note: Topic 18.7.3 with Table 18.4 and Quick Check 18.5, answered (PDF 29-30). Answers were derived and need review.

blocks.text: Exchanging ligands changes the size of the d orbital splitting, delta E, for the metal ion. The frequency of the light absorbed therefore changes, and so does the colour seen. In each case the new ligands (NH3 or Cl-) form a more stable complex than the original H2O ligands, with a different delta E and so a different colour.
